set.body:
scalafim's default B-spline HRF (Hrfs.bspline, BsplineConvention.LegacyR) matches released fmrihrf 0.4.0 hrf_bspline: splines::bs(intercept = FALSE), interior knots at quantiles of seq(0, span) (i.e. on [0, floor(span)]), first spline dropped, width max(N, degree + 1). BsplineParitySuite and HrfRParitySuite pin that behavior against 0.4.0 fixtures.

Unreleased fmrihrf commit 18d418f (2026-09-29, "Unify vignette plotting; fix B-spline and weighted HRF bases"; checkout HEAD 40c2125) redefines hrf_bspline(N) as the clamped basis with N + 2 functions, interior knots uniform over the actual span, and both the first and last splines dropped (every column vanishes at both ends; N columns; N >= max(1, degree - 1)). Verified numerically: hrf_bspline_HEAD(N) == scalafim Complete(N + 2)[, -c(1, last)], max |diff| = 0 over four configurations including fractional spans (docs/verification/hrf-complete-bspline-20261004/generate_complete_bspline_fixture.R).

Consequence: once fmrihrf releases 18d418f, scalafim's default no longer matches R (knot placement, column count and the zero at span all differ), and regenerating the R-parity fixtures from the new release will fail BsplineParitySuite / HrfRParitySuite / bspline_impulse.

Decide: (a) add a third BsplineConvention (e.g. both-ends-anchored, matching fmrihrf >= next release) and keep LegacyR pinned to 0.4.0 fixtures; or (b) move the default to the new R convention, which changes the default basis and its HRF identity (needs an identity-policy decision); or (c) document LegacyR as frozen to fmrihrf 0.4.0. Identity: a new convention can take a new tag in the bspline params record without a v3 bump (see the C5 receipt).

Found during C5 readiness (review/c5-hrf-complete-bspline-20261004).
set.title: Legacy B-spline default will diverge from fmrihrf once 18d418f is released
